concept: Aurora Serverless v2: relational DB for spiky/idle traffic
tests: Choosing the cheapest relational DB with no capacity management for unpredictable load and long idle periods.
expected: Aurora Serverless v2 — auto-scales ACUs, drops to a low minimum when idle, billed per ACU-second. Triggers: "relational", "unpredictable, spiky", "idle overnight", "avoid managing capacity".
why_not: Provisioned RDS Multi-AZ is paid for constantly; DynamoDB on-demand — not relational; Redshift — a data warehouse, not OLTP.
